paragraphs.text: We synthesize an LFP/C composite (LiFePO4/C, hereafter LFP/C) by a hydrothermal method for lithium-ion batteries.
Commercial carbon black was added as a conductive additive during electrode fabrication.
The LFP/C electrode delivered 149 mAh/g at 0.1 C.
Contrary to earlier sol-gel reports, our hydrothermal LFP/C shows higher rate capability than sol-gel derived powders.
